cut_items.item: Caching is misleading: a stale local `latest` vs a freshly pulled one on a clean CI runner can make environments disagree

Avoid bare major tags like `python:3`, which are still moving
Pinning by digest guarantees exact bytes while the tag stays for readability

added_items.item: Scan images in CI with a tool such as Trivy or Grype
Pinned images do not get security patches on their own, which is why updates must be managed
`:latest` does not necessarily mean newest or most stable; it is only the maintainer's default tag
Keep the version tag next to the digest as a comment or on the same line for readability
Exception: `:latest` may be acceptable for an internal image your own team controls and versions carefully
